text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: My, what an adorable rice ball...!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Did you make this
for me, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Yeah, it's a bit clumsy though.
Yeah, even if it looks a bit clumsy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Replenishing your nutrients right after training helps reduce muscle fatigue. So, I tried making some small rice balls.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much
for being so considerate!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I shall gratefully—
dig in♪

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Now then. Moisturizing and massage.
I have to make sure to do it thoroughly today too—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: (Somehow, my muscles feel less stiff than usual...)

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
(――...Oh, come to think of it,
Trainer brought some refreshments...)

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
(Fufu. The fatigue recovery effects
seem to be showing quite clearly.)

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much,
Trainer, and cute little rice ball♪
